caption_switching: Viewers are {} behind. Switching to {} at the next keyframe…
caption_buffering: Filling the delay: {}. Viewers stay live until then
caption_buffering_delayed: Filling the delay: {}. Viewers stay {} behind until then
caption_finishing: Your encoder disconnected. Viewers still see the last {}
r_no_stream: No stream is connected yet: start streaming in OBS first.
r_buffer_not_ready: The delay buffer is not ready yet.
r_invalid_in_mode: That is not possible right now.
r_transition_in_progress: Please wait for the current transition to finish.
r_unsustainable: This delay does not fit in memory at the current bitrate.
r_invalid_value: That value is out of range.
health_codec: Unsupported video codec: in OBS, Settings → Output, choose an H.264 encoder
health_keyframe_interval: Keyframe interval too long: in OBS, Settings → Output (Advanced mode) → Keyframe Interval: 2
health_keyframes_missing: No keyframes: in OBS, Settings → Output (Advanced mode) → Keyframe Interval: 2
health_b_frames: B-frames on: in OBS encoder settings, set B-frames to 0
health_timestamps: Irregular timestamps: check the encoder settings and CPU load
health_resolution: Resolution above the platform limit: lower it in OBS, Settings → Video → Output Resolution
health_upload_slow: Upload too slow: lower the bitrate in OBS, Settings → Output
health_no_video: No video: add a source to your OBS scene
health_no_audio: No audio: check the OBS Audio Mixer (mic or desktop audio)
health_bitrate_low: Bitrate very low: raise it in OBS, Settings → Output (about 2500–6000 Kbps)
health_bitrate_high: Bitrate too high for the platform: lower it in OBS, Settings → Output
setup_encoder_text: In OBS open Settings → Stream: Service "Custom…", Server: one of these URLs, Stream Key: the key from your platform (OpenDelay passes it on unchanged). Then Settings → Output, Output Mode "Advanced": Rate Control CBR, Bitrate 2500–6000 Kbps, Keyframe Interval 2 s. With a custom server OBS no longer applies the platform's settings, and without these viewers may only see a black screen.
setup_overlay_text: Add a Browser source with this URL (width 600, height 160). The background is transparent.
setup_dock_text: In OBS choose Docks → Custom Browser Docks, enter a name such as OpenDelay and this URL.
setup_app: Routes, hotkeys and the other settings are in the OpenDelay window.
